detail.description: MailWatch for MailScanner 是 MailScanner 的基于 Web 的前端。在 1.2.27 之前，任何经过身份验证的 MailWatch 用户（包括 U/用户、D/域管理员和 H/主机角色）都可以通过向“mailscanner/quarantine_action.php”提供任意消息“id”来释放到收件箱或永久删除任何其他用户或域的隔离邮件。操作路径调用“mailscanner/functions.php”中的“quarantine_list_items()”，它通过提供的标识符从“maillog”中进行选择，而无需通过列表和读取视图应用每个角色的“global_filter”。该操作需要有效的会话和 CSRF 令牌，但调用者可以从调用者自己的会话中提交令牌；所请求消息的所有权永远不会被检查。邮件标识符是可枚举的，允许低权限用户为其他用户或域的隔离邮件调用“quarantine_release()”或“quarantine_delete()”，强制传送隔离区保留的邮件或永久删除它。此问题已在 1.2.27 版本中修复。
detail.kind: 通过用户控制密钥绕过授权机制

detail_original.description: MailWatch for MailScanner is a web-based front-end to MailScanner. Prior to 1.2.27, any authenticated MailWatch user, including the U/user, D/domain-admin, and H/host roles, can release to inbox or permanently delete the quarantined mail of any other user or domain by supplying an arbitrary message `id` to `mailscanner/quarantine_action.php`. The action path calls `quarantine_list_items()` in `mailscanner/functions.php`, which selects from `maillog` by the supplied identifier without the per-role `global_filter` applied by listing and read views. The action requires a valid session and CSRF token, but the caller can submit a token from the caller's own session; ownership of the requested message is never checked. Message identifiers are enumerable, allowing a low-privilege user to invoke `quarantine_release()` or `quarantine_delete()` for other users' or domains' quarantined messages, force-delivering mail held by the quarantine or permanently deleting it. This issue is fixed in version 1.2.27.
